_about: The single registry of models (JP, 2026-11-25). To swap or add a model: edit this file (and, for a new provider, add a route in scripts/llm_batch.py). Scripts read prices, names, providers, roles and the origin policy from here. Prices are USD per million tokens, list prices; check 'price_source' and 'verified' before trusting one. Run scripts/selftest.py after any edit.

policy._about: Model-origin policy of 2026-11-25: hosted APIs only from developers in the allowed countries; open-weight models from any country may run locally if near the frontier. Change it here, not in code.

gemini-4-neon.notes: Thinking tokens are billed as output.

roles._about: Which model does which job. Change a role here to swap a model everywhere. Model procedure chosen by JP on 2026-11-27 (pending validation): one Neon rater with a Sol fallback for low-confidence ratings; Sol writes the first drafts and there is no critique, vote or tiebreak for drafts; Neon checks node details; Neon fixes errors only in EVDs with low decision-model scores; a model never checks its own work (items produced by Neon are judged by verify_judge, Sol; items produced by Sol are judged by verify_judge_alt, Neon; a quality rating is judged by the one of the two that did not rate it); Sol reads quote screenshots because Neon extracted the quotes. Claude Opus 5.5 is not used (JP, 2026-11-27); it stays in the registry. A role is a model id, or an object {key, model, effort}; the *_effort roles give an effort to a plain model id. Decision models (JP, 2026-11-27): roles.decision_models lists three voting models, Perplexity Decider 1.3, Liquid (d1.3-ultra when the API accepts it, d1.2-ultra until then) and Baseten bison-1; bison-1 and Perplexity read text only. max_output_tokens (per model, 2026-11-27) is the largest output budget (answer plus thinking) used for a request; Neon 65536 is the Gemini limit, the other three values are conservative and not yet confirmed against the providers' pages.

src_writer._about: Writes the SRC (source) page of a paper from the run's findings, drafted nodes and PDF text (scripts/write_src.py, stage src_write, prompt src-write-v1). Batch API only (JP, 2026-11-27).

src_judge._about: Judges each Findings bullet of a written SRC page against its EVD node and the extraction (write_src.py, stage src_judge, prompt src-judge-v1). Not the model that wrote the page (Sol). Batch API only (JP, 2026-11-27).

embedding_models._about: Local open-weight models for screening (scripts/screen_all.py reads its list from here in a later step; the paths are folders under ~/.cache/lives-bench/models).
